limits: The current single-init path and same-look quality rebuild are exercised at material-factory level, not full renderer execution.
Pool replacement still resets uCell; normal Meadow.update writes active cells before render. No direct render after hot replacement was tested.
Re-adoption test intentionally provides fresh non-meadow shader holders; calling applyIsland twice on already patched terrain is still outside its pre-existing non-idempotent contract.
No GPU compilation, resource-growth measurement, dispose reachability/GC proof or frame-time attribution.
